wages.text: Schneider says he has been outspoken that the federal minimum wage, then $7.25, needs to rise.
wages.quote: I've been very outspoken that the minimum wage needs to rise.

debt.text: Schneider says he will defend Medicare and oppose privatizing Social Security or turning Medicare into a voucher system.
debt.quote: I will defend the Medicare guarantee so that no senior will ever have to choose between heating their homes and maintaining their health.

immigration.text: Schneider supports comprehensive immigration reform with a pathway to citizenship and protections for DREAMers.
immigration.quote: It is essential that we enact comprehensive immigration reform that secures our border and includes a pathway to citizenship for those here illegally.

abortion.text: Schneider says he voted to codify Roe and will fight for a woman's right to choose.
abortion.quote: I'm proud of my vote to codify Roe and deliver the promise of safe health care to the next generation.

health.text: Schneider says health care is a right, supports the Affordable Care Act and opposes repealing it.
health.quote: Access to affordable, quality health care is our right, not a privilege reserved for only a few.

energy.text: Schneider calls climate change a grave threat and warns that failing to act will damage the planet.
energy.quote: Climate change is a grave threat to the ecological and environmental health of our nation and planet.

voting.text: Schneider says he supports legislation to strengthen the Voting Rights Act against discriminatory election laws.
voting.quote: I support legislation that would strengthen the Voting Rights Act by creating new pathways to challenge discriminatory election laws

tax.text: Lambrecht called for cutting the gas tax and reducing the number of taxing bodies to lower costs.
tax.quote: Cut the gas tax in half. This only the start.

energy.text: Lambrecht opposed state subsidies for an electric-vehicle battery plant and payments to electric car buyers.
energy.quote: Stop giving money to China to build a battery factory in Illinois. Stop giving $7,500 to buyers of electric cars.
